༄༅/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅/ /na maḥpradz+nyā pā ra mi tā yai/ chos rnams kun gyi de bzhin nyid// spros pa'i mtshan ma nyer zhi ba// rgyal ba'i yum dang de sras la// kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal te// pha rol phyin pa'i mngon rtogs rim// rgyal ba'i sras kyis legs par bsdus// de don gsal zhing go bde bar// cung zad tsam zhig bshad par bya// de yang srid pa'i gcong rong nyam nga bar mi shes pa'i mun pas ches gnags par gyur pa de las skye dgu rnams drang bar bya ba'i phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa de dag kyang bsdu na 'khor lo rim pa gsum du 'dus shing*/ de'i nang nas 'khor lo bar pa sher phyin gyi mdo 'di'i dbye ba la snga rabs pa rnams kyis stong phrag brgya pa/ nyi khri lnga stong pa/ khri brgyad stong pa/ shes rab khri pa/ brgyad stong pa/ sdud pa ste yum drug dang*/ sher phyin bdun brgya pa/ lnga brgya pa/ sum brgya pa/ tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ lnga bcu pa/ sgo nyer lnga pa/ kau shi kas zhus pa/ rab rtsal rnam gnon gyis zhus pa/ sher phyin yi ge nyung ngu*/ yi ge gcig ma/ shes rab snying po ste sras bcu gcig tu grangs nges mdzad cing*/ bcom ldan rigs ral gyis ni/ sher phyin mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad ma/ nyi ma'i snying po/ zla ba'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po/ lag na rdo rje/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan rnams sher phyin yin kyang bcu bdun du ma 'dus pas grangs nges mi 'thad gsungs so// de dag la ar byang chub ye shes kyis rgyas 'bring bsdus pa dgur dbye bar mdzad do/ /yum gyi dgongs 'grel la rgyal ba ma pham pas sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gtso bor ston pa mngon rtogs rgyan dang*/ klu sgrub kyis dngos bstan stong nyid kyi don ston pa dbu ma rigs tshogs drug dang*/ phyogs glang gis brgyad stong don bsdus dang*/ dpa' bo'i 'bum ṭīka te shing rta'i srol 'byed tshul bzh-ir grags pa'i dang po 'di la'ang rjes 'brang gi 'grel pa la/

thogs med sku mched kyis gzhan stong gi dbu mar bkral ba dang*/ 'phags pa grol sdes rang stong gi dbu mar dang*/ btsun grol gyis rang gi rnam dpyod dang mthun par bkral ba dang*/ shān+ti pa dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang*/ rarna kīrti/ bud+dha shrī/ a bhā ya sogs kyis 'grel pa mdzad do// de'i rjes su mkhas pa snga ma'i bstan bcos mthong zhing lo bcu bdun du dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas mthar byams pa nyid kyis lung bstan thob pa'i slob dpon seng ge bzang pos rgyan 'di la yum bar pa dang sbyar ba le brgyad ma'i bsdus don/ brgyad stong pa dang sbyar ba brgyad stong 'grel chen/ sdud pa dang sbyar ba sdud 'grel rtogs sla ba/ kun las khyad par 'phags pa'i yum gsum ga dang sbyar ba don gsal 'grel pa dbu ma chen po dang mthun pa 'di mdzad do// 'di la yang rgyas 'gyur gyi 'grel pa la/ ku lan+ḍa t+ta'i rtogs dka'i snang ba/ dharma mi tra'i tshig gsal/ nub kyi sgo glegs pa dang*/ kha che gzhon nu dpal gnyis kyi don bsdus rnams yod cing*/ gangs can du'ang 'grel bshad mang zhig byung ba las legs bshad du gyur pa kho bo'i 7rje bla ma rgyal ba karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa 'di'i rtsa ba dang mthun par bsdus te 'chad par bya ba la gsum/ lo tsā bas bstan bcos bsgyur ba'i yan lag tu mdzad pa/ yan lag de ldan gyi bstan bcos dngos/ mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba'o/ /dang po (lo tsā bas bstan bcos bsgyur ba'i yan lag tu mdzad pa )la gnyis te/ khungs btsun pa dang don rtogs pa'i phyir mtshan smos pa/ 'gyur mthar phyin pa'i phyir phyag 'tshal ba'o/ dang po (khungs btsun pa dang don rtogs pa'i phyir mtshan smos pa )ni/ rgya gar skad du/ a bhi sa ma ya a laṅkā ra nā ma pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta u pa de sha shās+t+ra/ bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa/

rgya gar na skad rigs la/ pi shā tsi/ a wa bh+raṃ sha/ pra kṛ ta/ saṃ kṛ ta dang bzhi yod pa'i nang nas saṃ kṛ ta'i skad du bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan la/ a bhi sa mā ya/ a laṅkā ra/ nā ma/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā u pa de sha shās+t+ra kā ri kā/ bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don rgya chen po tshig nyung ngus ston par byed pa'i man ngag gis gdul bya rnams rgyal ba'i bstan pa la gzhug pa'i phyir nyon mongs pa'i nad bcos pa'i thabs 'di la ni mngon par rtogs pa gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba yin la/ de nyid kyang tshig le 'ur byas pa ste tshigs bcad kho na yin no// gnyis pa ('gyur mthar phyin pa'i phyir phyag 'tshal ba )ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// ma rig bag chags dang bcas pa sangs shing shes bya la mtshan 'dzin med par mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas pa sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub de yid la sems shing bdud gzhom pa la dpa' ba'i dge 'dun thams cad la lo tsā bas bar chad zhi ba'i phyir phyag 'tshal bar mdzad do// mchod brjod/ gnyis pa yan lag de ldan gyi bstan bcos dngos 'chad pa la gsum ste/ gang zag gzhan 'bras yum la dang ba bskyed pa'i rgyu mchod brjod/ bstan bcos la dang ba bskyed pa'i rgyu dgos 'brel/ dang ba skyes nas 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs nyid bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun byams pas so so rang rig pa'i ye shes smra brjod dang bral bar mnyam par bzhag pa na yul du byas pa'i chos dbyings de la rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su yang dag pa'i rtog pas kun nas bslangs te ngag gis mchod par brjod pa la gnyis te/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi sgo nas yon tan brjod pa/ yon tan can gyi 'bras yum la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /dang po (mkhyen pa gsum gyi sgo nas yon tan brjod pa) la/ gzhi shes kyis nyan rang gi bzhed don sgrub nus par bstan pa ni/

nyan thos zhi ba 'tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir 'khrid mdzad gang yin dang*// gang zag nyan thos dang rang rgyal zhi ba 'tshol ba ste thob par 'dod pa rnams ni thabs phyi nang gi chos kun bdag med par shes pa nyid kyis bzhed don lhag bcas lhag med kyi nyer zhir 'khrid par mdzad nus pa gang yin pa dang*/ zhes so// 'di skabs kyi nyan thos ni shrā wa ka'i sgra las drangs na rang gi thos pa gzhan la sgrog pa ste/ de la dbye na/ lta ba khas len gyi nyan thos dang*/ sprul pa'i dang*/ rigs ma nges pa'i dang*/ nges pa'o/ /dang po gnyis ni byang sems la nyan thos kyi sgras bstan pa yin la/ phyi ma gnyis ni mtshan nyid pa'o/ /rang rgyal la dbye na/ bse ru lta bu/ tshogs spyod che chung gnyis dang gsum mo/ /de dag gi bzhed don ni/ gnas skabs kyi myang 'das te srog gi 'du byed ma btang la nyon mongs pa zhi ba'i lhag bcas dang*/ de btang la sdug bsngal spangs shing dge rtsa dang lam rgyun chad pa ni lhag med kyi myang 'das te/ mngon pa kun las btus pa las/ phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su nyan thos ni lam thams cad rgyun yang dag par gcod pa'i rnam par 'dor bas rnam par spong ste/ byang chub sems dpa' ni ma yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i gnas skabs su theg dman gyis rig pa rgyun chad par 'dod la/ sems tsam pas rig pa'i mtha' thug med yin pas rgyun ma chad par 'dod do/ /myang 'das de dag gi rgyu'i gtso bo ni nyan rang 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs kun shes nyid yin te/ des 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin spong ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa lam shes kyis byang sems kyi bzhed don sgrub nus par bstan pa ni/ 'gro la phan par byed rnams lam shes nyid kyis 'jig rten don sgrub mdzad pa gang*// gang zag byang chub sems dpa' 'gro la phan par byed 'dod pa rnams thabs lam gsum rang bzhin med par shes pa nyid kyis bzhed don 'jig rten pa dag gi don du gnyer bya'i byang chub gsum sgrub par mdzad nus pa gang yin pa dang*/

zhes so/ /byang sems de la rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i byang sems/ mnyan pa lta bu/ rdzi bo lta bu dang gsum mo/ /dbye ba de'i dang po ni/ byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam dang*/ phyi ma ni bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las grub pa yin no/ /de dag gis bzhed don ni/ byang 'phags rang rgyud kyi lam shes kyis sgrub pa yin te/ thabs snying rje chen po dang ldan zhing*/ shes rab lam gsum ga khong du chud pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyis sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub nus par bstan pa ni/ gang dang yang dag ldan pas thub rnams rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs 'di gsungs pa// gang zag 'bras yum gang dang yang dag ldan pa'i thub pa zag pa gsum dang bral ba chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'dod pa rnams ni thabs rnam pa rtags mtshan ma kun skye ba med par mkhyen pa dang ldan pas bzhed don chos kyi phung po sna tshogs pa 'di dag gsung bar nus pa yin no/ /bzhed don de ni rang gi mngon rtogs rnam mkhyen gyis sgrub nus pa yin te/ des gdul bya'i khams la 'jug pa'i phyir ro// 'dir chos 'khor gyi mtha' dpyad pa la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya'i sgra bshad/ mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba'o/ /dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ ston pas bstan pa'i dam chos gang zhig gdul bya'i sdug bsngal dang sgrib pa sel byed nyid yin te/ sdug bsngal dag ni thams cad dang*/ /sgrib kun sel byed dam pa'i chos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa (mtshon bya'i sgra bshad )ni/ chos zhes bya ba ni dhṛ dha ra ṇa 'dzin pa la 'jug pa yin pas/ rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin par byed pa ste/ rnam mkhyen gyi rang mtshan chos thams cad mngon sum du mkhyen pa de 'dzin pa lta bu'o/ /'khor lo ni myur bar 'gro ba la sogs pa 'khor lo rin po che dang chos mtshungs pas so// gsum pa (mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba )la/ rtogs pa'i chos dang*/

lung gi chos so/ /dang po'i mtshan nyid ni/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo goms pas bskyed pa'i rnam byang gi bden pa'o/ /dbye na gnyis kyi dang po ni/ de bzhin nyid la dmigs pas zag pa dang bral ba'i 'gog bden te/ slob mi slob kyi spangs pa dang*/ lhag med kyi myang 'das sam chos sku'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'gog pa de thob byed kyi thabs zag med lam bden te/ mthong lam dang sgom lam mo// gnyis pa (lung gi chos )la lnga ste/ mtshan nyid/ ngo bo/ gsungs tshul/ dbye ba/ grangs nges kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po (mtshan nyid) ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i ngo bo rgyu 'bras gang rung brjod byar ston pa'i ngag gang zhig /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis po gang rung gis bsdus pa'o/ /bcu gnyis ni/ 1 phan yon bcu gzigs nas smos pa'i tshul gyis ston pa mdo sde/ 2 de'i dbus mthar tshigs su bcad pa dbyangs bsnyad/ 3 'byung 'gyur lung ston pa/ 4 rkang pa gnyis pa nas drug pa'i bar gyi tshigs bcad/ 5 bstan pa gnas pa'i don du yi rang ba la ched du brjod pa/ 6 gang zag gi ched du byung ba dang bcas pa'i bslab pa gsungs pa gleng gzhi/ 7 dpe dang bcas pa rtogs brjod/ 8 gang zag gzhan gyi byung tshul bstan pa de lta bu byung ba/ 9 rang gi byang chub tu spyad pa spyod tshul gsungs pa skyes rabs/ 10 byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang ldan pa'i shin tu rgyas pa/ 11 'phags pa rnams kyi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos/ 12 mtshan nyid phyin ci ma log par ston pa gtan la dbab pa'i sde rnams so/ /de'i dang po lnga ni nyan thos kyi mdo sde/ de 'og bzhi ni 'dul ba/ de 'og gnyis ni byang sems kyi mdo sde/ gcig ni nyan thos dang theg chen gnyis ka'i mngon pa'i sde snod do// gnyis pa (ngo bo )ni/ lung gi chos de dag kyang chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong du gnas la/ chos phung ni mdo sde pas tshig dang*/ bye smras ming du 'dod pa yin te/

mdzod las/ tshig gam ming yin de dag kyang*// gzugs sam 'du byed dag tu 'dus/ /zhes so// sems tsam pas/ nyan pa po'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i sgrar snang ba'i rnam rig la 'dod do// chos phung gi tshad la/ sh+lau ka drug stong dang*/ phung po sogs brjod byar ston pa'i gtam rgyud re re dang*/ 'dod chags sogs nyon mongs pa re re'i gnyen po la dang*/ glang po che sa la rab brtan gyis khur nus pa'i snag tshas chos phung gcig 'bri nus par 'dod pa sogs so// gsum pa (gsungs tshul) ni/ rnam pa bcu'i sgo nas legs par gsungs pa ste/ bcu ni/ 1 yang dag par bslang ba nyid kyis dang*/ 2 dbang du mdzad pa dang*/ 3 'jug pa dang*/ 4 rab tu brtan pa dang*/ 5 rab tu dbye ba dang*/ 6 rten dang*/ 7 go bar mdzad pa dang*/ 8 gdags pa dang*/ 9 dus dang*/ 10 yon tan yongs su 'dzin pa nyid rnams so// bzhi pa (dbye ba )ni/ chos 'khor rim pa gsum du phye ba ni theg chen pa'i lugs yin la/ de la'ang rnam bzhag mi 'dra ba bzhi yod de/ 1¿mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ bka' dang po bden bzhi'i 'khor lo/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i 'khor lo/ tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o// 2¿gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdor/ bden pa bzhi'i tshul/ stong pa nyid kyi tshul/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i tshul zhes gsungs so// 3¿de'i dgongs 'grel du rgyud blar/ 'jig rten zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa'i dang*/ rab tu smin pa'i dang*/ lung ston pa'i 'khor lo zhes gsungs so// 4¿klu sgrub kyis ni/ dang po bdag ston pa'i dang*/ bar du bdag med ston pa'i dang*/ tha mar lta ba kun bzlog pa'i 'khor lo zhes gsungs so// de ltar bshad pa las lugs snga ma gsum du ni/ dang por bden bzhi/ bar du spros bral/ tha mar chos dbyings ye shes bden grub tu ston par mtshungs so/ /lugs phyi mar ni/ dang por thabs kyi cha/ bar du

rnam grangs pa'i don dam/ tha mar spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba ston pa yin no// des na nges don mthar thug tu ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na ngag gi rgyu 'byung ba dang kun slong med pas sangs rgyas kyis chos gcig kyang ma bstan la/ nges don tsam du ni rim pa gsum ga gcig car du gsungs kyang*/ gdul bya rnams kyi mos pa'i dbang gis so sor go ba yin te/ sems can rnams kyi bsam pa yis// bskul bas sangs rgyas gsung 'byung ngo*/ / de la 'dir rtog yongs mi mnga'/ /zhes dang*/ gsung gcig nyid du gsungs mod kyang*// du ma nyid du so sor go/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// drang don du ni chos 'khor rnams rim gyis gsungs pa yin la/ de yang rnam bzhag dang po'i dbang du byas te rim pa gsum po so so la/ gnas/ dus/ 'khor/ chos bzhi bzhis 'chad pa las/ rim pa dang po ni/ 'khor mo 'jig tu lo bdun gyi bar du lnga sde dang lha mang po la bden pa bzhi lan gsum bzlas pas bcu gnyis so/ /bar pa ni/ bya rgod phung ri na lo nyi shu rtsa bdun du dge slong pha ma dang*/ dge bsnyen pha ma lnga stong dang*/ byang sems bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag la sher phyin ston pa rnams so/ / tha ma ni/ ri ma la ya dang*/ yangs pa can la sogs par lo bcu ru/ 'khor theg pa sna tshogs la mos pa dag la kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub ston pa rnams so//

lnga pa (grangs nges kyi khyad par )ni/ kun rdzob bden pa gtso bor ston pa ni drang don gyi mdo yin la/ dbye na/ pha dang ma ni bsad bya zhing*/ /zhes pa lta bu log pa'i kun rdzob ston pa dang*/ tshogs bsags pa las bde ba 'byung*/ /zhes pa lta bu yang dag kun rdzob ston pa gnyis so/ /don dam pa'i bden pa gtso bor ston pa ni nges don gyi mdo yin zhing*/ de'i dbye ba la thogs med sku mched kyi lugs las ni/ sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa nges don gyi drang don/ sgra ji bzhin pa nges don gyi nges don gyi mdo zhes 'byung ngo*// klu sgrub yab sras kyi lugs las/ spros pa phyogs re bkag pa'i de bzhin nyid ston pa gnas skabs pa'i nges don dang*/ spros pa ma lus pa bkag pa'i de bzhin nyid ston pa mthar thug gi nges don gyi mdo zhes 'byung ngo*// des na mdo sde dgongs 'grel nas gsungs pa'i 'khor lo rim pa gsum po de la drang nges so sor 'byed na/ 'khor lo dang po la nges don dang*/ phyi ma gnyis la drang don gyi cha yod mod/ gtso che ba'i dbang du byas na dang po drang don dang phyi ma gnyis nges don du theg chen pa dag mthun yang*/ khyad par ni/ rnam rdzun pas 'khor lo bar pa sgra ji bzhin pa'i nges don du mi 'dod la/ ngo bo nyid med smra bas sgra ji bzhin pa'i nges don du 'dod do/ /'dir 'di ltar shes dgos te/ 'khor lo bar par ngo bo nyid kyi ma skyes zhes sogs la skrag pa skyes pa'i gang zag gi don du 'khor lo tha mar yod med so sor dbyes nas/ gzhan dbang la kun brtags kyis stong pa'i yongs grub yod ces gsungs la/ de'i tshe lta bas spros pa gcod pa na 'khor lo bar pa nges don dang*/ sgom pas nyams su myong ba na tha ma nges don du 'gro ba yin no// gnyis pa yon tan can gyi yum la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas sangs rgyas kyi ni yum de la phyag 'tshal lo//

kun shes kyi sgo nas nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang*/ lam shes kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas rnams la phan 'dogs par byed pa'i yon tan can gyis ni yum de la rje btsun byams pas bstan bcos rtsom pa'i thog mar phyag 'tshal bar mdzad do// 'dir 'phags bzhi'i yum du 'jog pa'i tshul ni/ 'bras yum la gzhi lam rnam gsum skye ba med pa'i yon tan gyi cha gsum yod la/ de gsum ni so sor 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs yin te/ yum bar pa las/ rab 'byor thams cad shes pa nyid ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no// lam shes pa nyid ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don no/ /mngon rtogs des ni rang rang gi bzhed don sgrub pa'i sgo nas phan 'dogs par byed pas yum du gyur pa yin la/ yum mtshan nyid pa de yang 'phags lam thob pa yan chad kyi gang zag gi rgyud la yod kyi de phyin chad na ni med de/ mos spyod kyi gnas skabs su gzhi shes dang lam shes mtshan nyid pa med pa'i phyir te spang bya'i sa bon la mi gnod pa'i phyir ro//rgyun mtha' man chad na rnam mkhyen mtshan nyid pa yang med de chos thams cad kyi rnam rtags mtshan ma skye med mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i phyir ro//'on kyang rjes mthun pa ni yod par blta'o// 'dir 'di ltar dogs te/ yum la mkhyen pa gsum gyi sgo nas bstod pa 'di mangs pas/ rnam mkhyen gcig pu'i sgo nas bstod par 'thad cing*/ yang na nyungs te dngos po brgyad ka'i sgo nas bstod dgos so snyam na/ skyon dang po med de/ de ltar gyi tshe na nyan rang byang sems rnams yum la dang ba mi skye ba'i phyir ro/ /skyon phyi ma med de/ mkhyen gsum 'di'i nang du dngos po gzhan brgyad 'dus pa'i phyir ro//

'dus tshul yang*/ chos sku ni rnam mkhyen las logs su med cing*/ sbyor bzhi ni mkhyen gsum gyi rgyu yin pas 'bras bus rgyu bsdus pa lta bu yin no// 'dir gzhi lam rnam gsum gyi de kho na nyid yum la skye med spros bral gyi sgo nas bstod pa las 'phros nas spros mtshan 'gog tshul cung zad bshad na/ gang zag tu 'dzin pa 'gog /chos su 'dzin pa 'gog pa'o/ /dang po (gang zag tu 'dzin pa 'gog pa )la/ phyogs snga bkod/ de dgag pa'o/ /dang po (phyogs snga bkod pa) la/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin lhan skyes ni/ grub mthas blo ma bsgyur ba'i 'gro ba kun gyi rgyud la yod pa'i phung po'i tshogs pa la dmigs nas ngar 'dzin pa tsam mo// kun btags ni/ de la blos sna tshogs su brtags pa phyi rol pa rnams kyi smra ba ste/ phyi rol pa la rtsa ba'i dbye ba/ 1 rgyang 'phen pa/ 2 grangs can pa/ 3 dbang phyug pa/ 4 khyab 'jug pa/ 5 gcer bu pa dang lnga/ dang pos 'jig rten pha rol med par 'dod pas chad smra/ lhag ma rnams rtag smra ba yin no// dang po rgyang 'phen pa ni/ phur bus lha ma yin las g.yul rgyal ba'i ched du tshe phyi ma med pa'i bstan bcos brtsams pa la brten nas byung zhing 'dzam gling du rengs byed kyi bu lhag spyod sogs snyoms 'jug pa drug /rgyu rgyal la sogs rjes sgrogs pa drug /'od srungs rdzogs byed sogs rtog ge pa'i ston pa drug rnams su yod la/ 'byung bzhi'i dus na mi gsal ba'i bdag dang lus sems zung du 'jug pa na gsal ba'i bdag sogs 'dod/ 2¿grangs can pa ni/ tshe lo dpag med kyi dus byung ba'i drang srong ser skyas rang gi ji ltar rtogs pa gzhan la bstan pa las byung zhing lhag bcas lhag med gnyis su gyes la/ gtso bo'i glor gnas pa'i bdag za po dang*/ rtag pa dang*/ shes rig yin pa sogs 'dod/ 3¿dbang phyug pa ni/ drang srong rkang mig dang gzegs zan gyis dbang phyug la brten nas byas shing*/

rig pa can pa/ bye brag pa/ gsal byed pa/ rna ba ma phug pa dang bzhir gyes la/ bdag de lus dbang po blo sogs kun la khyab kyang gson pa'i lus kho na la gnas shing yon tan bcu ldan sogs 'dod/ 4¿khyab 'jug pa ni/ rgyal dpogs dang gzhon nu ma len las byung zhing tshangs pa/ dpyod pa pa/ brda sprod pa/ rig byed mtha' pa/ gsang ba pa dang lngar gyes la/ shes rig rtag pa'i bdag tu 'dod/ 5¿gcer bu pa ni/ drang srong rgyal ba dam pa las byung zhing khyu mchog sogs kyi rjes 'brang las nyi shu rtsa lngar gyes la/ bdag rdzas su 'dod pa ste mdor na kun kyang bdag rtag par khas len pa'o// gnyis pa (de dgag pa )ni/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ mu stegs rnams kyis gang btags pa'i// bdag de rigs pas brtags na 'dir// phung po las ni gzhan nyid du// nam yang rnyed pa ma yin no// phung po yin na de mi rtag/ ces dang*/ 'jug pa las kyang*/ de ltar btags pa'i bdag chos can/ tha snyad du yang dngos por yod pa ma yin te ngar 'dzin gyi yul ma yin pa'i phyir te ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi khyod du ma bzung ba'i phyir/ yang rang sde mang bkur ba'i nang tshan gnas ma bu pa sogs kha cig phung po las de nyid dang gzhan du med pa'i bdag 'dod pa la/ 'jug par/ bdag mang po dang rdzas grub dang 'jig lta kun brtags su mi 'gyur bar thal/ phung po bdag yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'gog par mdzad do// gnyis pa (chos su 'dzin pa 'gog pa )la'ang gnyis las/ dang po (phyogs snga bkod pa )ni/ chos kyi bdag 'dzin lhan skyes ni/ myu gu la dmigs nas myu gu'o snyam du 'dzin pa tsam ste grub mthas ma bsgyur ba'o/ /kun btags ni/ de la sna tshogs su brtags pa ste/ dbye na gzung ba bden grub smra ba/ rnam shes bden grub smra ba'o/ /dang po (gzung ba bden grub smra ba )la/ grub mtha' smra ba po'i dbye ba/ 'dod pa rags rim brjod pa'o/ /dang po (grub mtha' smra ba po'i dbye ba )ni/

ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang drug cu na rgyal po mya ngan med kyi dus grong khyer me tog gis rgyas par dge 'dun 'khrugs nas phal chen pa dang*/ gnas brtan pa gnyis su gyes/ dang po la brgyad/ phyi ma la bcur gyes pa'am/ yang na dang po la drug /phyi ma la bcu gnyis su gyes pa'am/ yang na rtsa ba gnyis po de'i steng du rnam par phye ste smra ba dang gsum gyis dang po la brgyad gnas brtan pa la drug phye ste smra ba la bzhir phye ba'am/ yang na dul ba lhas bshad pa ltar/ thams cad yod smra bdun/ phal chen pa lnga/ gnas brtan pa gsum/ mang bkur ba gsum ste rtsa ba'i sde bzhi/ gyes pa'i sde pa bco brgyad de 'dren tshul gyi khyad par ro// de dag kyang grub mtha' gtso che bar bsdu na/ gnas ma bu sogs lngas bdag 'dod pa dang*/ lhag ma rnams de mi 'dod pa'i dbye bas gnyis su phye ba'am/ yang na yod smra'i nang tshan sa ston sde pa ni mdo sde pa dang*/ lhag ma rnams bye brag tu smra ba ste gnyis su 'du'o// gnyis pa ('dod pa rags rim brjod pa )la/ mi mthun pa dang*/ mthun pa'o/ /dang po (mi mthun pa )ni/ sde pa bco brgyad so so'i 'dod tshul zhib mo rnams yi ges 'jigs la/ bye mdo'i khyad par ni/ rim pas mngon pa sde bdun bka' yin min/ lung chos 'du byed dang gzugs phung du 'dod pa/ rdul phran rnams ma reg pa dang reg par gnas pa/ rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs sgrub 'gog /dbang po gzugs can tshad ma yin min/ rgyu 'bras dus mnyam 'dod mi 'dod/ don snang gi shes pas phyi don rnam med rjen gcer du 'dzin par 'dod pa dang mi 'dod pa/ snang ba sems su mi 'dod pa dang 'dod pa/ dbyibs dus gsum ldan min 'du byed rang skya thub pa'i rdzas su dang cha la btags pa'i brtags par 'dod pa/ 'gog bden dngos por 'dod mi 'dod/ de bzhin nyid mi 'dod pa dang 'dod pa/ shes pa rang rig mi 'dod pa dang 'dod pa/

bya 'brel ldan pa rnams byed po 'brel can thos po las don gzhan dang don gcig 'dod pa/ lus shes bde ba bsam gtan gyi yan lag tu mi 'dod pa dang 'dod pa/ dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu las nyams pa yod med/ lus la sems kyi sa bon mi 'dod pa dang 'dod pa/ rags pa rtsom pa la rdul rdzas brgyad ka dgos mi dgos/ sems byung so brgyad po nang phan tshun rdzas gzhan 'dod pa dang*/ kun 'gro lnga ma gtogs btags yod rdzas gcig 'dod pa/ rten 'brel re re ba phung po lnga tshogs dang phung po re rer 'dod pa 'di dag ni khyad par ro// gnyis pa (mthun pa )ni/ phung khams skye mched kyi dbye ba/ skye gnas bzhi/ 'gro ba lnga/ zas bzhi/ rdul phran chung mtha' bden grub/ rags pa rdzun pa/ sems sems byung*/ 'byung 'gyur 'byung ba las/ shes pa mtshungs ldan las/ ldan min 'du byed gnas skabs can las skye ba/ bden bzhi/ lam lnga/ nyan rang byang sems sogs kyi lam bgrod tshul/ rgyal bu don grub kyi tshe so skyer 'dod pa/ bsam gzugs kyi 'dod tshul phal cher/ sangs rgyas sa na rnam smin gyi phung po yod pa/ lhag med rig pa zad pa/ zag pa'i rnam bzhag gzhig cing blos sel nus pa bum pa lta bu kun rdzob bden pa dang*/ de ltar mi nus pa'i gzugs dang bde ba lta bu don dam bden par 'dod pa sogs so// gnyis pa rnam shes bden grub smra ba ni/ sems tsam rnam bden pa ste sems la shar ba'i don gyi rnam pa bden par 'dod pas so/ /dbye na gzung 'dzin gyi cha so sor rdzas gzhan bden par 'dod pa'i sgo nga phyed tshal ba/ gzung ba'i rnam pa ji snyed du shes pa yang 'dod pa'i gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa/ rnam pa sna tshogs kyang shes pa gcig gi rang bzhin du 'dod pa sna tshogs gnyis med pa dang gsum du yod/ gnyis pa de dgag pa la/ dbu ma pa ngos bzung*/ des bstan pa'i rigs pa'o/ /dang po (dbu ma pa ngos bzung ba )ni/ theg pa chen po dbu ma pa la'ang bden gnyis gtan la phab pa'i sgo nas bka' bar pa nges don du 'grel ba'i klu sgrub dang*/

rang bzhin gsum gtan la phab pa'i sgo nas bka' mtha' ma nges don du 'grel ba'i thogs med de srol 'byed kyi gtso bo gnyis byung ba de dag gi rjes 'brang yang mtha' yas la/ snga ma'i rjes 'brang las snang med pa dang*/ phyi ma las rnam bden pa sogs don dam las cung ring ba 'phags yul du'ang byung zhing gangs can du ni mu cor smra'o/ /mchog gnyis po de ni snga mas chos can blo bur ba stong bya la dgongs shing*/ phyi mas chos nyid kyi gnas tshul stong gzhi la dgongs nas grub mtha' bzhag la/ des na 'di gnyis gzhi 'gyur med bde gshegs snying po/ lam de'i 'khrul pa sel byed/ 'bras bu de sgrib bral sku'i rnam bzhag rnams mthun pa'o// gnyis pa (des bstan pa'i rigs pa )ni/ thogs med kyis ming don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa ldog par mdzad de/ lto ldir ba'i don de bum pa'i ming dang gcig pa 'gal te/ gcig na brda mi shes pa'i byis pas lto ldir ba mthong ba'i tshe bum pa'o snyam pa'i blo skye srid par thal ba la de mi skye ba dang*/ gzhan yang brgya byin mang por dang*/ yul yul can 'dres pa dang*/ me brjod pa'i tshe kha tshig par 'gyur ba'i skyon sogs gsungs so/ /klu sgrub kyis kyang bden grub 'gog byed kyi rigs pa lnga gsungs pa'i mtha' ma rten 'brel kyi rigs pa ni/ phyi nang gi dngos po rnams chos can/ bden par med de/ rten 'brel tsam yin pa'i phyir/ 'di'i phyogs chos sgrub sla zhing khyab pa yang*/ grub mtha' 'og mas rten 'brel 'dod cing de'i don ltos grub tu 'dod la ltos grub dang bden grub 'gal bas so/ /des na 'di ni tha snyad 'ba' zhig sgrub kyi rtags so/ /'dir rje btsun gyi mchod brjod 'di ni mdo'i gleng gzhi'i don 'grel ba yin te/ dge slong lnga stong tsam zhes pa ni/ nyan thos zhi ba 'tshol zhes sogs dang*/ byang sems bye ba khrag khrig ces pa ni/

'gro la zhes sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das zhes pa dang*/ thub rnams zhes sogs go rim mthun pas so// dgos 'brel/ gnyis pa gzhan bstan bcos la dang ba bskyed pa'i rgyu dgos 'brel ni/ mchod brjod kyi mjug tu rtsom par dam bca' dgos 'brel gyi sgo nas bstan cing*/ de yang mdo'i don bshad thabs yan lag lnga'i tshul gyis bshad par mdzad la/ yan lag lnga ni/ dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang*// tshig don bcas dang mtshams sbyar bcas// brgal lan bcas te bsnyad par bya// zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de dag gi go rim yang rgyan 'di la mtshon na/ dgos 'brel gyi dgos don dang*/ lus rnam bzhag gi bsdus don dang*/ yan lag rgyas bshad kyi tshig don bstan pa dang*/ go rim mi 'khrugs par mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ rigs pa dang mi 'gal ba/ snga phyi mi 'gal ba'i brgal lan gnyis ni skabs skabs su bstan pa ltar ro// de la dgos sogs dang por 'chad rigs te/ ji srid dgos pa ma bstan pa// de srid du ni su yis 'dzin// zhes gsungs pas so/ /de la dgos 'brel ngag la yod pa'i dgos sogs/ bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos sogs so/ /dang po (dgos 'brel ngag la yod pa'i dgos sogs )ni/ bstan bcos kyi dgos sogs chos bzhi ni dgos 'brel ngag gi brjod bya/ ngag de las bstan bcos la dgos sogs yod pa thog mar go ba ni dgos pa/ go ba la brten nas dpyod ldan bstan bcos la 'jug pa ni nying dgos/ snga ma snga ma phyi ma phyi ma la 'brel ba ni 'brel pa'o//

gnyis pa (bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos sogs )ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// ston pas 'di las bshad pa gang*// gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin te// chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid kyi// mdo don dran pa la bzhag nas// blo dang ldan pas mthong 'gyur phyir// bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes// bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin// gzhung dang sbyar nas 'chad de/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mtshon byed kyi chos bcu la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob byed kyi lam/ ston pa de bzhin gshegs pas yum 'di dag las bshad pa gang yin pa de ni bstan bcos rgyan gyi yang brjod bya yin no/ /phyi rol pa dang nyan rang sogs gzhan gyis myong bar nus pa ma yin te/ chos sku de ni sbyin pa la sogs pa chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid kyis sgrub nus par mdo las gsungs pa'i don dran pa la bzhag nas byang sems blo dang ldan pas lam der zhugs pa na chos sku mthong ba'am rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes pa ni nying dgos yin no/ /byang chub sgrub pa la yum gyi don bde blag tu ni rtogs pa dgos so zhes bya ba'i phyir bstan bcos rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin no/ /nying dgos dgos pa las dgos pa brjod bya las byung ba'i 'brel ba ni brjod bya dgos pa nying dgos bstan pas rtogs nus pa yin no// 'o na dgos sogs la bzhir grangs nges sam zhe na/ nges te/ log rtog bsal bya la brjod bya med pa dang*/ 'bras bu med pa dang*/ thabs med pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i don 'grub par mi 'gyur snyam pa ste bzhi yod pas/ sel byed dgos sogs la yang bzhir grangs nges pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa la gsum ste/ rgyas pa la mos pa'i gang zag la brgyad du bstan pa/ 'bring la mos pa'i gang zag la drug tu bstan pa/ bsdus pa la mos pa'i gang zag la gsum du bstan pa'o/ / lus rnam gzhag/ dang po (rgyas pa la mos pa'i gang zag la brgyad du bstan pa )la/

lus rnam gzhag dang*/ yan lag rgyas bshad gnyis las/ dang po (lus rnam gzhag )la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad// gzhung shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i brjod bya ni/ lam dang 'bras bu'i sher phyin dngos po brgyad kyi don du gnas la/ de dag ni 'dir yang dag par bshad do// 'di'i skabs su sher phyin la gsum du yod pa las/ 'bras bu sher phyin ni/ chos rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma glo bur ba thams cad dang bral ba de'o/ /lam sher phyin ni/ de dri ma dang bral rim ste/ dbye na/ gtso phal gnyis kyi snga ma la yang mos spyod kyi gnas skabs kyi zag bcas dang*/ mthong sgom gyi gnas skabs kyi zag med gnyis su yod de/ zla ba snying pos zhus pa las/ mos pas spyod pa'i sa'i gnas skabs kyi gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams te/ de spong bar byed pa ni zag par bcas pa'i sher phyin yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la zag pa med pa'i sher phyin ni mthong ba'i lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes te/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /phal pa ni nyan rang dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa ste/ 'bum ṭīka las/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi mthar phyin pa'i sas bsdus pa dgra bcom pa'i lam gyi ye shes kyang sher phyin gyi rgyu mthun pa yin pas sher phyin gyi ming thob par 'gyur ro// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// gzhung sher phyin ni/ 'bras bu sher phyin de thob pa'i thabs ston par byed pa'i ming tshig gi tshogs so/ /des na 'bras bu sher phyin ni sher phyin dngos yin la/ lam ni shes rab yin gyi sher phyin ma yin kyang 'bras ming rgyu la btags pa dang*/ gzhung ni shes rab tsam yang min kyang brjod bya'i ming gis rjod byed la btags pa yin no/ /de skad du 'grel chen las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu de ni dngos yin la/

de thob pa dang rjes su mthun pa nyid kyis na tshig dang ngag gi tshogs kyi gzhung dang mthong ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi lam la yang sher phyin zhes bya ba ni btags pa'o/ /zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la gnyis te/ bshad bya dngos po brgyad/ 'chad byed don bdun cu'o/ /dang po (bshad bya dngos po brgyad )la gsum ste/ dngos po brgyad so so'i don/ go rim nges pa/ mdo dang sbyar ba'o/ / dang po (dngos po brgyad so so'i don )la/ brgyad las rnam mkhyen la bzhi ste/ mtshan nyid/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams so// rnam kun mkhyen nyid dang po ni/ chos thams cad skye med du mngon sum du rtogs shing*/ don gnyis mthar thug pa'i ye shes de yin no/ /de la ni kha cig gis sangs rgyas kyi sa na sems sems byung rnams med pas rang snang la ye shes med do zhes gsung*/ kha cig gis ye shes sgyu ma lta bu yod par 'chad/ 'o na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de la kun rdzob kyi snang ba mnga'am mi mnga' zhe na/ slob dpon kha cig ni chos can ji snyed pa skyu ru ra rlon pa lag mthil du bzhag pa ltar snang yang mtshan 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa mi 'byung ste/ sgrib gnyis kyi sa bon ma lus pa spangs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'dir ni mkhyen nas chos rnams ma gzigs phyir/ /zhes gsungs pas 'khrul snang mi mnga' bar 'chad dgos so// gnyis pa (sgra bshad )ni/ chos thams cad kyi rnam pa dang*/ rtags dang*/ mtshan ma kun skye med du mngon sum du mkhyen pa nyid do// gsum pa (dbye ba )ni/ chos nyid ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i mnyam bzhag dang*/ de dang dbyer med pa'i chos can ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rjes thob gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po ni/ mdo las/ rab 'byor chos gcig gis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya ste zhi ba'i rnam pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang ngo gsal stong gi cha nas bzhag la/ phyi ma ni/ shes bya'i rnam pa thams cad skye ba med par mkhyen pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'o//

bzhi pa (sa mtshams )ni/ rnam mkhyen mtshan nyid pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar yod cing*/ rjes mthun pa ni de man chad kyi 'phags lam na'ang yod de/ ji lta ba sa dang po nas dang*/ ji snyed pa sa brgyad pa nas so// gnyis pa lam shes pa la yang snga ma ltar bzhi las/ lam shes nyid// dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ lam gsum gzod ma nas skye med du rtogs shing shes sgrib kyi gnyen por gyur pa de'o/ /gnyis pa (sgra bshad )ni/ lam thams cad khong du chub pa'am shes shing lam gyi bya ba yang byed pa nyid do/ /gsum pa (dbye ba )ni/ theg gsum gyi lam gsum rtogs pa dang*/ rtogs pa de dag gzod ma nas zhi bar shes pa gnyis so/ /bzhi pa (sa mtshams )ni/ sa dang po yan chad nas yod do// gsum pa kun shes la yang bzhi las/ de nas thams cad shes pa nyid// dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pas nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por gyur pa de'o/ /gnyis pa (sgra bshad )ni/ de nas gzhi phung khams skye mched thams cad bdag med par shes pa nyid do/ /gsum pa (dbye ba )ni/ mtshan 'dzin dang bcas pa spang bya'i gzhi shes dang*/ mtshan 'dzin dang bral ba'i gnyen po'i gzhi shes gnyis so/ /bzhi pa (sa mtshams )ni/ dang po nyan rang gi mthong lam nas/ phyi ma ni sa dang po nas yod do// bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba la'ang*/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang*// dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ mkhyen gsum rtogs par bya ba'i phyir gzhi lam rnam gsum rang bzhin med par sgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa (sgra bshad )ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i chos la sogs pa'i rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs phyir du sgom pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ gsum pa (dbye ba )ni/ sbyor ba bzhi'am nyi shu'o/ /bzhi pa (sa mtshams )ni/ tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha' man chad na'o// lnga pa rtse sbyor la'ang*/ rtse maur phyin dang ¿ dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ gzhi lam rnam gsum rang bzhin med par sgom pa rab tu gyur pa'o/

/gnyis pa (sgra bshad )ni/ rnam kun gyi rtse mor te rab kyi mthar phyin pa dang*/ gsum pa dbye ba ni/ sbyor mthong sgom bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor dang bzhi'o/ /bzhi pa (sa mtshams )ni/ drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar na'o// drug pa mthar gyis pa la'ang*/ mthar gyis pa// dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ rtse sbyor la brtan pa thob pa'i phyir rim gyis sgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa (sgra bshad )ni/ mthar gyis pa ste snga ma'i rjes su phyi ma 'brel bar sgom pa'o/ /gsum pa( dbye ba )ni/ bcu gsum mo/ /bzhi pa (sa mtshams )ni/ drod nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs bar ro// bdun pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la'ang*/ skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub// dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom la brtan pa thob pas cig car sgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa (sgra bshad )ni/ rim gyis phar phyin dag la goms pas/ bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma gcig la mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa yin no/ /gsum pa (dbye ba )ni/ mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bzhi yod do/ /bzhi pa (sa mtshams )ni/ rgyun mtha' kho na la'o// brgyad pa chos sku la'ang*/ chos kyi sku dang dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ sbyor bzhi'i 'bral bu mthar thug go / gnyis pa (sgra bshad )ni/ zag pa med pa'i chos thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa'i sku dang*/ gsum pa (dbye ba) ni/ sku gsum phrin las dang bcas pa'o/ /bzhi pa (sa mtshams )ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na la'o// gnyis pa go rim nges pa ni/ de rnams brgyad// nyams su blang bya skye med gsum shes par bya ba'i phyir mkhyen gsum bstan/ de dag nyams su blang ba'i thabs sbyor bzhi/ nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu chos sku bstan pa ni/ spyi'i go rim/ bye brag tu'ang rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu yin pas sems bskyed sogs chos bcu dang por bstan/ de dag gi don du gnyer bya yang lam shes la rag las pas lam shes bstan/

de'i mthun phyogs dang mi mthun phyogs ngo shes pa'i phyir gzhi shes bstan pa ni mkhyen gsum gyi go rim mo/ /mkhyen gsum mngon du bya ba'i phyir sgom pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ de mngon par rtogs pa'i tshul gyi sgom pa rtse sbyor/ de la brtan pa thob par bya ba'i phyir sgom pa mthar gyis pa/ de la brtan pa thob nas cig car du sgom pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba rnams ni sbyor bzhi'i go rim mo/ /de ltar na dngos po rnam pa brgyad po de dag ni/ skabs brgyad kyi don du gnas la/ dngos po re re bas kyang skyes bu'i lam yongs rdzogs re re ston no// de yang gong du mkhyen gsum gyi mtshan nyid dang dbye ba la sogs pa bstan pa ni/ gang zag dang 'brel ba'i mngon rtogs bsdu byed mkhyen gsum yin la/ bsdu bya'i mkhyen gsum ni de dag mtshon byed de/ skabs dang po gsum kyi brjod byar gyur pa'o// gsum pa mdo ni/ rab 'byor gyi le'us rnam mkhyen/ mtha' gnyis rnam dag gi le'us lam shes/ spyod pa khyad par gyi le'us gzhi shes/ de bzhin nyid kyi le'us rnam kun/ bslab pa yongs su dag pa'i le'us rtse sbyor/ rim gyis 'jug pa'i le'us mthar gyis pa/ bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'us skad cig ma/ bslab pa 'bras bu'i le'us chos sku rnams bstan to/ / gnyis pa 'chad byed don bdun cu bshad pa la gsum ste/ mkhyen gsum mtshon byed kyi sgo nas bshad/ sbyor bzhi ngo bo'i sgo nas bshad/ chos sku dbye ba'i sgo nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po (mkhyen gsum mtshon byed kyi sgo nas bshad pa )la gsum las/ dang po (rnam mkhyen )ni/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang*// nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi dang*// sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang*// dmigs pa dag dang ched dang ni// go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang*// tshogs ni nges par 'byung bcas rnams//

thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid// rdzogs byang gi sa bon du gyur pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ de smin cing dag par byed pa'i rkyen theg chen gyi gdams ngag dang*/ de nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu'i thog mar nges par 'byed pa mthong lam gyi yan lag ste rgyur gyur pa'i sbyor lam rnam bzhi dang*/ de thob pa na theg chen du rigs nges pas sgrub pa'i ni rten du gyur pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin can gyi rigs dang*/ sgrub pa de'i dmigs pa dag dang*/ sgrub pa de'i ched du bya ba dang ni/ de nas sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la dbye na mi mthun phyogs kyis mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir go cha bgos pa'i sgrub pa dang*/ go bgos nas theg chen gyi g.yul du 'jug pa'i bya ba sgrub pa dang*/ g.yul du zhugs nas dpung gi tshogs dag sog pa'i sgrub pa dang ni/ de nas dgra las rgyal ba nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa dang bcas pa de ltar bcu po rnams kyis thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid ni yul gyis yul can nam rgyus 'bras bu mtshon pa'i sgo nas bstan no// gnyis pa (lam shes )ni/ mog mog por byed la sogs dang*// slob ma bse ru'i lam gang dang*// 'di dang gzhan pa'i yon tan gyis// phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam// byed pa dang ni mos pa dang*// bstod dang bkur dang bsngags pa dang*// bsngo dang rjes su yi rang ba// yid la byed pa bla med dag/ sgrub dang shin tu dag pa zhes// bya ba 'di ni sgom pa'i lam// byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi// lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad// lam shes skye ba'i rten du bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis lha rnams kyi 'od mog mog por byed pa dang la sogs pas yul nges pa dang khyab pa dang rang bzhin dang byed las rnams bsdus so/ /shes bya'i lam la ni/ slob ma nyan thos kyi lam dang*/ bse ru lta bu la sogs pa'i rang rgyal gyi lam gang dang*/

theg chen kyi lam la dbye na/ tshe 'di dang gzhan pa phyi ma'i yon tan can gyi phan yon che ba dang ldan pa'i mthong ba'i lam dang*/ sgom lam gyi byed pa ste phan yon dang ni/ byed pa can gyi sgom lam la/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i rjes thob dang*/ zag med mnyam bzhag gnyis yod pa'i dang po la dbye na/ yum la yon tan can du 'dzin pa'i mos pa dang*/ de dag gi 'bras bu bstod pa dang bkur ba dang bsngags pa gsum dang*/ dge ba mi zad par byed pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ 'phel bar byed pa'i rjes su yi rang ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam dang gsum mo/ /gnyis pa zag med la/ rtogs pa phun tshogs sgrub pa sgom lam dang*/ spangs pa phun tshogs shin tu dag pa zhes bya ba 'di ni sgom pa'i lam ste gnyis so/ /de ltar bcu gcig po de dag gi byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa rnams kyi lam shes nyid ni yul gyis yul can mtshon pa'i sgo nas de 'drar bstan no// gsum pa (gzhi shes )ni/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dang*// thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang*// thabs kyis ring ba ma yin nyid// mi mthun gnyen po'i phyogs dag dang*// sbyor dang de yi mnyam nyid dang*//

nyan thos la sogs mthong ba'i lam// de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod// dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du shes pas srid pa la mi gnas shing*/ sems can la snying rje bas dman pa zhi ba la mi gnas pa dang*/ shes sgrib spong ba'i thabs la mkhas pa ma yin pas 'bras yum la ring ba dang*/ de spong ba'i thabs kyi lam la mkhas pas 'bras yum la ring ba ma yin pa nyid dang*/ mi mthun phyogs mtshan 'dzin gyi 'du shes dang bcas pa nyan rang gi dang*/ 'du shes de dang bral ba gnyen po'i phyogs byang sems kyi gzhi shes dag dang*/ gnyen po'i gzhi shes la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ de'i yul yul can mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa dang*/ sbyor ba de'i 'bras bu nyan thos dang*/ la sogs pas byang sems kyi mthong ba'i lam shugs dang dngos la bstan pa ste/ de ltar dgu po de 'dra bas ni kun shes nyid yul can gyis yul dang*/ rgyus 'bras bu mtshon pa'i sgo nas bstan pa nyid du 'dod do// gnyis pa sbyor bzhi la bzhi las/ dang po (rnam rdzogs kyi sbyor ba )ni/ rnam pa sbyor bar bcas rnams dang*// yon tan skyon ni mtshan nyid bcas// thar dang nges 'byed cha mthun dang*// slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs// srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid dang*// zhing dag bla na med pa ni// rnam kun mngon rjogs rtogs pa ste// 'di ni thabs mkhas bcas pa yin// gang bsgom par bya ba don shes kyi rnam pa dang*/ ji ltar sgom par bya ba sbyor ba dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i yon tan dang*/ de la bar du gcod pa'i skyon dang ni/ sbyor ba de rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang bcas pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i 'bras bu thar pa cha mthun tshogs lam dang*/ de yongs su smin pa nges 'byed cha mthun dang*/ sbyor ba sgom pa po'i gang zag slob pa phyir mi bzlog pa'i tshogs dang*/ srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ rang gi zhing dag yon tan bla na med par bsgyur ba dang ni/

gzhan yongs su smin par byed pa 'di ni thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba dang bcas pa ste bcu gcig po 'di rnams kyis ni rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba bstan pa yin no// gnyis pa (rtse mo'i sbyor ba )ni/ de yi rtags dang rnam 'phel dang*// brtan dang sems kun gnas pa dang*// mthong zhes bya dang bsgom pa zhes// bya ba'i lam ni so so la// rnam par rtog pa rnam bzhi yi// gnyen po rnam pa bzhi dang ni// bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin// log par bsgrub dang bcas pa ni// rtse mo'i mngon rtogs bsdus bsgoms rab tu gyur pa de'i rtags drod dang*/ bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba rtse mo dang*/ mkhyen gsum dang sems can gyi don mi gtong ba la brtan pa'i bzod pa dang*/ sems dmigs pa la kun tu gnas pa'i chos mchog dang*/ mthong zhes bya ba dang sgom pa zhes bya ba'i lam ni so so'i gnas skabs la gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa re re la gnyis gnyis su phye bas rnam pa bzhi'i gnyen po rnam pa bzhi dang ni/ sangs rgyas pa la lam gzhan gyi bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ bar chad med lam gyi spang bya bden gnyis 'gal bar rtsod pa'i log par sgrub pa dang bcas pa'i ni chos brgyad po de dag gi rtse mo'i mngon rtogs bstan pa yin no// gsum pa (mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba )ni/ mthar gyis pa// rnam gsum rnam bcu bsam pa phun tshogs rjes dran drug dang*/ sbyor ba phun tshogs phar phyin drug dang*/ dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi sbyor ba ste rnam pa gsum dang rnam pa bcu po de dag gis mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba bstan no// bzhi pa (skad cig ma'i sbyor ba )ni/ skad cig ma// gcig gis mngon rjogs byang chub pa// mtshan nyid kyis ni rnam pa bzhi// bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma gcig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa de yin la/

dngos po tha dad du dbye ba med kyang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis ni rnam pa bzhi yod do// gsum pa chos sku 'chad pa ni/ ngo bo nyid longs rjogs bcas dang*// de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni// chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa// rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod*// gdod ma nas dri ma dang bral ba'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang*/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang bcas pa dang*/ de bzhin du 'khor ba ji srid par rgyun mi 'chad cing nges pa lnga ldan las gzhan pa'i sprul pa'i sku dang ni/ ye shes chos sku bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i mdzad pa dang bcas pa phrin las te/ de ltar rnam pa bzhir ni chos sku'i dbye ba yang dag par brjod pa yin no//
